unity-developer.name: Unity developer
unity-developer.when_to_use: Use for Unity/C# gameplay, performance, or editor tooling vacancies. Prefer the Go backend variant for backend-only roles.

base.headline: Unity / C# Game Developer
base.summary: Unity engineer with gameplay, UI, performance, and editor tooling experience on desktop games. Combines hands-on C# development with technical planning and release ownership.

experience.title: Senior Unity Engineer
bullets: Built Unity and C# gameplay systems for Harborlight Tactics, a cooperative strategy game shipped on desktop.
Reduced frame time from 24 ms to 16 ms through profiling, object pooling, and asset-loading changes.
Designed a shared Unity editor toolset used by 12 designers across 2 projects.
Led technical planning for 5 engineers and reviewed architecture, estimates, and release risks.

experience.title: Unity Developer
bullets: Developed C# gameplay and UI systems for Clockwork Orchard in Unity.
Built an automated content validation pipeline that reduced manual review time by 40%.
Integrated save migration and crash telemetry for 3 desktop releases.

experience.title: Technical Lead
bullets: Led a team of 8 engineers delivering Go services for an invoice reconciliation platform.
Reduced reconciliation latency from 900 ms to 280 ms by profiling Go workers and tuning PostgreSQL queries.
Introduced release checklists and staged rollouts, reducing production incidents by 35%.
Coordinated quarterly plans across 3 product teams and mentored 4 engineers.

skills.items: Unity, Addressables, uGUI, Editor tooling, Profiling, Object pooling

unity-developer.notes: Lead with shipped desktop games, frame-time improvements, and editor tooling. Keep recent leadership as evidence of ownership; shorten backend details when space is limited.

go-backend.when_to_use: Use for Go services, data processing, APIs, and backend technical lead vacancies. Select the Unity variant for gameplay-focused roles.
